meta.name: Venue Showcase Banner Post
meta.description: Square post with a full-bleed hero photo of a space, a solid color title panel on the upper left with a small kicker and a two-line serif title, a logo at the top center and a footer bar with website and phone; built for showcasing a venue, interior, property or premium product.

background.prompt: A full-bleed, photorealistic hero photo of the space, scene or product setting the brief promotes (this template: a sunlit luxury restaurant interior with cream bouclé banquettes, marble tables, brass pendant lamps, arched botanical wall panels and floor-to-ceiling windows onto a city skyline), shot at a wide eye-level angle with deep perspective so it fills the whole square. The upper-left block (about 0–48% across, 20–39% down) will be covered by a solid title panel and the bottom 6% by a solid footer bar, so keep the scene's focal point and its most important details in the middle and right of the frame, not hidden there. Keep the top center (about 40–62% across, 0–16% down) a calm, light, low-detail area such as a pale ceiling, wall or sky, because a dark logo sits there. Warm natural daylight, rich but clean detail. Colors, materials, props and styling follow the brief; add accents only if they genuinely suit its theme, keep them few and natural to the scene, and never copy this template's own decorations. IMPORTANT: keep the top-center logo area light and uncluttered — no lamps, beams, signs or dark objects there. No text, lettering, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
background.notes: Text regions and what they read against: the kicker 'ELEVATED SPACES' (gold rgb(222, 170, 85), bold, letter-spaced) and the title 'For Extraordinary / Experiences' (white Playfair Display) sit on the solid maroon panel layer rgb(116, 17, 34) at 0–48% across, 20–39% down; the website and phone (gold) sit on the maroon footer bar layer in the bottom 6%, next to gold globe and phone icons. Panel and footer are layers, not part of this image, so the photo under them is hidden. The only thing that reads directly on the photo is the logo (Quick Hub black placeholder, top center, 43–59% across, 2–15% down), so that area must stay light and calm. Fixed: the light top-center logo area and the focal point kept clear of the panel and footer. Everything else, including colors, setting and mood, follows the brief.

slots.notes: Solid maroon title panel on the upper left, behind the kicker and the title.
Solid maroon footer bar carrying the website and phone.

Main title: white bold serif on the maroon panel, two short lines of 3–5 words in total, left-aligned under the kicker, e.g. 'Crafted for Slow Evenings', 'Homes Built Around You', 'Taste the Season at Our Table'. A third line would run out of the bottom of the panel, so keep it to two lines.
Short gold rule between the kicker and the title, mostly hidden under the title.

Really a small KICKER above the title: gold, bold, letter-spaced capitals, 1–3 words on one line naming the category, e.g. 'NEW MENU', 'SPRING COLLECTION', 'LUXURY LIVING'. Longer copy wraps into the title.
Website in the footer bar, gold, right after the globe icon. Use only a real URL from the request (e.g. 'www.brewhouse.co'); otherwise keep the sample.

image.notes: Gold globe-in-circle icon at the left of the footer bar, marking the website. Fixed: never regenerate.

slots.notes: Gold globe icon beside the website.

image.notes: Gold phone-in-circle icon on the right of the footer bar, marking the phone number. Fixed: never regenerate.

slots.notes: Gold phone icon beside the phone number.

Phone number in the footer bar, gold, right after the phone icon. Use only a real number from the request (e.g. '+1 (512) 555-0147'); otherwise keep the sample. Over ~18 characters it wraps off the bar.

image.notes: Brand logo — reuse the asset exactly as supplied. Never regenerate, recolor, re-crop, or let a filler touch this layer; only ever swap in a different brand's own logo file.

slots.notes: Quick Hub placeholder (logo_black.png, stacked variant) at the top center, on the light ceiling of the photo.
